chunks: When he had supplied their provisions, he said to them: "Bring your (half) brother with you. Have you not seen that I have given full measure, and that I am the best of hosts?"
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Joseph say to his brothers when they returned with provisions?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (AS) requests his youngest brother Benjamin to accompany his siblings, leveraging his reputation for fair measurement and generous hospitality to build trust. Shia exegetes highlight this as a strategic divine plan (Tadbeer Ilahi) to gradually reunite the family and test the brothers' repentance, fulfilling the earlier dream. The emphasis on 'best of hosts' underscores Joseph's moral superiority and the political wisdom of his governance in Egypt.
